ideas.pitch: An interactive problem-solving platform and code visualizer specifically tailored for mastering company-style Java Online Assessments, featuring live execution tracking for array sliding-window and graph algorithms.
ideas.title: JavaOA Trainer & Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core domain of the assessment by offering a tool that helps participants prep for and understand the exact types of DSA and Java concepts evaluated in company OAs.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance algorithmic visualization and testbench utility built in Java to solve complex subarray and resource-allocation problems like 'Longest Subarray With Equal 0s and 1s' and 'Minimum Platforms' under strict constraints.
ideas.title: SubarrayPointer: Subarray & Platform Optimization Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific algorithmic challenges highlighted in Section 1 of the assessment with optimized Java data structures and clear step-by-step state visualization.

ideas.pitch: A combined technical reference and interactive quiz runner focusing heavily on DBMS normalization, indexing strategies, and Computer Networks protocol layers tailored for technical recruitment assessments.
ideas.title: NetDB Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the technical MCQ requirements (DBMS and Computer Networks) by providing an interactive review environment with deep-dive technical explanations.

ideas.pitch: A modular Java sandbox environment highlighting tricky core Java concepts such as memory models, multithreading edge cases, garbage collection behaviors, and OOP principles typically tested in OAs.
ideas.title: CoreJava Concept Lab
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the 5 Java Programming MCQs in the assessment by demonstrating rigorous understanding of core language fundamentals through runnable code samples and benchmark tests.

ideas.pitch: A timed coding assessment simulator replicating online assessment constraints, automatic evaluation of DSA submissions, and instant grading breakdown for DBMS, Networking, and Java core topics.
ideas.title: OAMetrics & Proctoring Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a meta-solution matching the exact format of the online assessment, allowing students to practice and test their proficiency across all sections under timed conditions.
